guide.title: Payment Plan Guide
guide.brief: Generated by contract payment nodes, with due reminders and commission triggers. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Plan Generation
steps.desc: Auto-generated by contract payment nodes (deposit/balance/installments) on signing.

steps.title: Trigger Methods
steps.desc: Supports triggers by signing, invoicing, settlement, or shipping.

steps.title: Due Reminders
steps.desc: Auto-reminds sales staff and customers before due dates to avoid missed collections.

steps.title: Payment Registration
steps.desc: Register and reconcile actual payments; record bank reference and arrival date.

steps.title: Commission Linkage
steps.desc: Payment completion auto-triggers commission rules, calculated by payment amount.

guide.title: Sales Refund Guide
guide.brief: Refunds based on sales orders, multi-level approval then executed. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Initiate Refund
steps.desc: Based on shipped or paid sales orders; fill refund reason and amount.

steps.title: Refund Review
steps.desc: Multi-level approval by amount; approvers can view order details and refund reason.

steps.title: Item Recovery
steps.desc: If return is needed, generate a return warehousing order; stock auto-increases.

steps.title: Refund Method
steps.desc: Supports original route (WeChat/Alipay) and offline (bank transfer/cash).

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Pending → Approving → Approved → Refunding → Completed / Rejected.
